svg.title: AWS Spring Boot Configuration Flow
svg.desc: Spring Boot startup flow for remote S3, Secrets Manager, and Parameter Store property sources before normal bean binding and auto-configuration.
svg.text: Remote configuration is loaded before bean binding; failed lazy refresh keeps the previous property values.

g.text: S3 / Secrets Manager / SSM SDK present
path names mapped to dotted keys
earlier configured source has higher priority

svg.text: Reader contract: S3, Secrets Manager, and Parameter Store values enter Spring Environment before AWS client beans and Exposed registry are created.
If a lazy reload fails, the previous property values remain active.
